title: Maximum Fanout-Free Window Enumeration: Towards Multi-Output Sub-Structure Synthesis
problem: AIG optimization peephole algorithms need efficient enumeration of multi-output sub-structures (Maximum Fanout-Free Windows) beyond single-output cuts.
motivation: Logic synthesis optimization benefits from efficient multi-output sub-structure enumeration for larger design spaces and improved rewriting/technology mapping.
method: Two enumeration styles for MFFWs: Dynamic approach adapts to AIG structural changes, Static approach optimizes performance when AIG remains stable; both applied to circuit rewriting and technology mapping.
key_novelty: First exploration of fanout-free windows as multi-output sub-structures with dynamic/static enumeration algorithms for AIG optimization.
contributions: MFFW sub-structure definition and characterization for AIGs
Dynamic enumeration method adapting to AIG changes
Static enumeration method for stable AIG structures
Application to circuit rewriting and technology mapping with performance gains

metrics.other: improved runtime performance in rewriting and technology mapping

limitations: Specific scalability benchmarks and performance metrics not detailed in abstract.
primary_theme: multi-output sub-structure enumeration for logic synthesis
